uutiset.t: Lampard calls for fairness after Coventry penalty row
uutiset.s: Coventry boss Frank Lampard wants officials to spend time ensuring they get decisions correct in the wake of his side being denied a penalty at Everton.

uutiset.t: Alcaraz puts aside injury concerns to take apart Cobolli
uutiset.s: A ruthless Carlos Alcaraz puts aside his injury concerns to dismantle Flavio Cobolli and ensure a perfect record in the ATP Finals group stages.

uutiset.t: Shevchenko lying about drugs test claims - Mudryk
uutiset.s: Mykhailo Mudryk accuses Ukraine legend Andriy Shevchenko of lying about the circumstances surrounding the winger's positive drugs test as his dispute with the country's football federation continues.

uutiset.t: Watch: Inverness and Ayr play out goalless draw
uutiset.s: Inverness Caledonian Thistle and Ayr United play out a goalless draw in the chilly Highlands.

uutiset.t: Osimhen keen on Man Utd move - Saturday's gossip
uutiset.s: Victor Osimhen is keen on a move to Manchester United, Aston Villa are interested in Amad Diallo and Ivan Toney is a target for Crystal Palace, plus more.

uutiset.t: F1 bosses agree V8 engines deal from 2030
uutiset.s: Formula 1 bosses reach a deal that means V8 turbo hybrid engines will replace the current controversial units in 2030.

uutiset.t: Wales players gaining confidence in Prem - Williams
uutiset.s: Exposure to the English Prem has boosted the confidence of Wales' players, says scrum-half Tomos Williams.

uutiset.t: A men's netball World Cup - not a question of if, but when?
uutiset.s: England and Jamaica's men's netball teams will act as curtain-raisers for the women's sides in this weekend's Horizon Series in London - and as the sport grows, an inaugural men's World Cup is on the cards.

uutiset.t: Bowen brothers needed extra protection after threats
uutiset.s: James Bowen is the latest jockey to confirm he has received death threats from angry punters, revealing both he and brother Sean needed extra protection after an incident last year.

uutiset.t: 'Right time' for Smith exit - but Murray not ready for role
uutiset.s: Leon Smith steps down as Britain's Davis Cup captain after almost 17 years, but "standout candidate" Andy Murray is unlikely to replace him.

uutiset.t: Man Utd fan criticism has gone too far at times - Berrada
uutiset.s: Manchester United chief executive Omar Berrada says some of the recent criticism of the club's hierarchy has "crossed a line".

uutiset.t: Stacked England aim to pile on style and add to All Black misery
uutiset.s: England's easy-on-the-eye revival will be stress-tested by a New Zealand side under sudden pressure on Saturday

uutiset.t: 'No-one is going to break us' - defiant Boks face Ireland without Erasmus
uutiset.s: South Africa prepare to face Ireland in a much-anticipated Nations Championship Test in Dublin without banned head coach Rassie Erasmus.

uutiset.t: Mowbray support no surprise, says interim boss Johnson
uutiset.s: Blackburn Rovers interim boss Damien Johnson says the support shown for head coach Tony Mowbray shows the high regard he is held in.
